Paste a post (Alert Ingestor)

A messy street post becomes a structured alert at low trust (0.30). It needs confirmations from other people before it changes routes.

You are

Alerts

  1. ≥ 0.60 active: hard
  2. 0.30–0.59 unverified: soft ×1.25
  3. 0.15–0.29 fading: no effect
  4. < 0.15 expired

Share a rickshaw or CNG

Commuters at the same hub split one ride. The split bot divides the engine's fare range for that link (with rush / rain surge) and rounds each share up to whole taka.
